heroHeadline: Six Madrid Nights Done — 384,000+ Fans; Pope Leo XIV's Viral Bad Bunny Quip Dominates Weekend Press
heroSubtitle: Bad Bunny completes Night 6 of his 10-night Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour residency at Riyadh Air Metropolitano. Six sold-out nights (Clusters 1–3: May 30, 31, June 2, 3, 6, 7) have drawn approximately 384,000 fans. Night 5 (June 6) featured 'Coco Chanel' as the exclusive song; Night 6 (June 7) featured 'Como Antes.' The June 6–7 weekend delivered a viral international moment: Pope Leo XIV, making his first apostolic visit to Spain, joked that 'many will see Bad Bunny' over the Pope — the remark was covered by AP, NBC, ABC News, and The Hill, as ~500,000 pilgrims gathered at Plaza de Lima the same night as Night 5. 'DtMF' holds at No. 1 on Billboard Hot Latin Songs for its 62nd consecutive week (chart dated June 6, 2026), continuing to extend its all-time record. The residency's final two clusters are June 10–11 (Cluster 4) and June 14–15 (Cluster 5). Pixar's Toy Story 5, in which Bad Bunny voices 'Pizza with Sunglasses,' opens in 12 days (June 19, 2026).
